metrics.tokenDefinition: LaTeX command tokens matched by \\(?:[A-Za-z]+|single non-letter/non-whitespace character).
metrics.matching: Multiset overlap by exact command token; micro metrics aggregate token counts and macro metrics average per-sample precision/recall/F1.
metrics.referencePrivacy: Raw reference LaTeX is not copied into the report; image and reference hashes remain the join evidence.

boundary: Command-token overlap is a lexical structural diagnostic. It does not establish TeX parsing, rendered-image equivalence, mathematical semantic equivalence, held-out accuracy or quality on another backend.
